diff --git a/tests/test_repair_extension_defaults.py b/tests/test_repair_extension_defaults.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_repair_extension_defaults.py
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+import pytest
+
+from asyncua import Server, ua
+from asyncua.common.structures104 import new_struct, new_struct_field
+
+
+SCALAR_TYPES = (
+    "String", "Int16", "Int32", "Int64", "UInt16", "UInt32", "UInt64",
+    "Double", "Float", "Byte", "SByte",
+)
+
+
+async def imported_struct(name, with_optional_fields):
+    server = Server()
+    await server.init()
+    namespace = await server.register_namespace("urn:test:extension-defaults")
+    fields = [
+        new_struct_field("Required" + name, getattr(ua.VariantType, name))
+        for name in SCALAR_TYPES
+    ]
+    if with_optional_fields:
+        fields.extend(
+            new_struct_field(
+                "Optional" + name, getattr(ua.VariantType, name), optional=True
+            )
+            for name in SCALAR_TYPES + ("Boolean",)
+        )
+    await new_struct(server, namespace, name, fields)
+    await server.load_data_type_definitions()
+    return getattr(ua, name)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("with_optional_fields", [False, True])
+async def test_required_scalar_defaults_have_their_declared_value_type(with_optional_fields):
+    name = "RepairMixedScalarDefaults" if with_optional_fields else "RepairScalarDefaults"
+    struct_type = await imported_struct(name, with_optional_fields)
+    value = struct_type()
+    for scalar_name in SCALAR_TYPES:
+        constructor = getattr(ua, scalar_name)
+        example = constructor() if scalar_name == "String" else constructor(0)
+        default = getattr(value, "Required" + scalar_name)
+        assert isinstance(default, type(example)), (
+            scalar_name, "default must be a value of the declared scalar type", default
+        )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_optional_scalar_defaults_preserve_unset_versus_explicit_zero():
+    struct_type = await imported_struct("RepairOptionalScalarDefaults", True)
+    value = struct_type()
+    for scalar_name in SCALAR_TYPES + ("Boolean",):
+        assert getattr(value, "Optional" + scalar_name) is None, scalar_name
+    value.OptionalInt32 = ua.Int32(0)
+    assert value.OptionalInt32 == 0
+    assert struct_type().OptionalInt32 is None

(
bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh
)
REPAIR_RC=$?
cd /testbed || exit 1
if [ -x /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 ]; then
  PATH=/opt/test_venv/bin:$PATH
  export PATH
  python() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
  python3() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
fi
/opt/test_venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_repair_extension_defaults.py -q
REPAIR_NEW_RC=$?
if [ "$REPAIR_NEW_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit "$REPAIR_RC"
